channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ian Mahinmi | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ian Mahinmi from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: John Wall on Ian Mahinmi
item.description:
Candace Buckner:John Wall on Ian Mahinmi returning to lineup:

“I think this is the biggest stepping stone, just to see if he can play... See how he (does) and find ways to put him into the rotation.”

John Wall on Ian Mahinmi, Feb 8, 2017. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Ian Mahinmi
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Scott Brooks on Ian Mahinmi:

“We’ll see how he feels tomorrow and maybe participate in some of our practice.”

Scott Brooks on Ian Mahinmi, Feb 2, 2017. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Bouna Ndiaye on Ian Mahinmi
item.description:
Agent Bouna Ndiaye on Ian Mahinmi and Strasbourg:

“It's nothing but rumors so far. I got in touch with the GM of Strasbourg, but for now is more rumor than anything else.”

Bouna Ndiaye on Ian Mahinmi, Sep 26, 2011. Source: Basket Europe.
